catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: revenue $1.31B (+29% YoY), GAAP net income $0.2B, GAAP diluted EPS $0.38; company raised full-year revenue growth forecast; shares rose ~6.4% intraday

Moderna reported Q3 2026 results: revenue $1.31B (+29% YoY; U.S. $780M, international $533M), swinging to GAAP net income of $162M (diluted EPS $0.38) from a $200M net loss (-$0.51/share) in Q3 2025. Raised FY2026 revenue-growth guidance to 15%-25% (from 'up to 10%'), improved FY2026 GAAP operating-expense guidance by ~$0.2B, and raised the FY2026 year-end cash-balance outlook to $8.1B-$8.3B (including $2.6B net proceeds from a convertible notes offering). The release also reiterated the Phase 3 melanoma-vaccine data and mFLUSIVA flu-vaccine approval already on file as separate catalysts.
catalysts.impact: Shares rose on the print (premarket +8% to +8.5%; intraday levels were reported variously between roughly $241 and $258 through the session, with gains described as fading later in the day) -- no single, independently confirmed closing price or percent change for 2026-11-06 was established this session, so the price block below was left unchanged rather than guessed.

catalysts.headline: Health Canada authorized Moderna's mRNA seasonal influenza vaccine (mFLUSIVA) and its combination influenza/COVID-19 vaccine (mCOFLU) — Canada became the first country to authorize both
mRNA-2808 Phase 1/2 data in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma presented at the American Society of Hematology (ASH) 2026 meeting

Merck and Moderna presented full Phase 3 INTerpath-001 data (intismeran autogene + Keytruda vs. Keytruda alone, in resected Stage IIB-IV melanoma) at the ESMO 2026 Presidential Symposium in Madrid, following the Oct 22 data leak. At a median follow-up of 24.6 months: recurrence-free survival was improved, reducing the risk of recurrence or death by 42% (HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.45-0.75, two-sided p<0.001); distant metastasis-free survival was improved, reducing risk by 38% (HR 0.62, 95% CI 0.45-0.85, p=0.002). Overall survival remains immature and not yet statistically significant, though investigators reported a favorable trend. No new safety signals vs. prior studies. The companies said the data have been accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine.

Embargoed Phase 3 melanoma-vaccine data (intismeran autogene / mRNA-4157 + Keytruda, with Merck) apparently leaked via the Oncology Central site ahead of its scheduled ESMO presentation; reported results showed a 42% reduction in recurrence risk and 38% reduction in distant metastasis vs. Keytruda alone -- better than many analysts expected -- but shares still fell ~18-26% (sources differ) that session. Commentary attributed the drop to valuation/sell-the-news positioning (stock up >8x YTD before the drop) rather than the data itself; Citigroup had downgraded Moderna to Sell shortly before. Merck fell only ~2% the same day.
catalysts.impact: -18% to -26% (sources differ) on 2026-10-22; CNBC reported the slide was still continuing as of 2026-10-26 premarket (-8%)

catalysts.headline: Moderna announced it will report Q3 2026 financial results on Friday, November 6, 2026, with a conference call at 8:00am ET

Juan Andres returns to Moderna as Chief Operating Officer overseeing manufacturing, as the company adds a COO role ahead of the potential launch/scale-up of intismeran autogene; Jerh Collins (chief technical operations and quality officer) is retiring

Citigroup analyst Geoff Meacham downgraded Moderna to Sell (from Neutral/Hold) while raising his price target to $80 from $60, arguing valuation had run ahead of the business (stock up roughly 222% since the August INTerpath-001 interim readout) and that the price assumed success across multiple tumor types at very large eventual sales.
catalysts.impact: Shares fell about 6% on the downgrade day (Sept 30, 2026); recovered about 3% the next session.

Merck/Moderna Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial (intismeran autogene / mRNA-4157/V940 + Keytruda) met primary (RFS) and key secondary (DMFS) endpoints in resected Stage IIB-IV melanoma -- first positive Phase 3 readout for an individualized mRNA cancer therapy

catalysts.headline: RESOLVED (was pending on file): the FDA approved mFLUSIVA (Moderna's standalone mRNA seasonal flu vaccine, mRNA-1010) for adults 50 and older -- Moderna's second commercially approved mRNA vaccine, following the June 2026 unanimous 9-0 advisory-committee vote
catalysts.impact: Reported +3.6% premarket at $58.30 the morning of the approval (2026-08-06); note this predates the subsequent large rally that took the stock into the $200+ range by October.
